label_corrections: After the first run, two labels were corrected and the tool was not changed to fit them: retrieval_failure expected the lowercase text 'no successful' where the message is 'No successful' (typo); clear_overlap expected a high lexical reading from a candidate that supplied full text but no abstract, which the documented rule scores on the title only, so that case now supplies an abstract. The run also showed the report did not say which text the lexical reading used, so a lexical_basis field was added.

After an independent code review of the tool, the rules (not only labels) changed and these labels were updated to match, each because the review showed the old behaviour overstated what the input supports: misleading_abstract now expects 'inconclusive' because a 'none' that the lexical cross-check contradicts is not a finding; capped_search now records a reviewed candidate because results with no reviewed candidate are 'inconclusive' (new case results_but_no_candidates); retrieval_failure's needle changed because error text no longer appears in coverage_limits (it is untrusted and rendered inside the fence); q_unicode_nfc uses a longer quote because a verbatim span under 4 words or 20 characters no longer counts (new case q_too_short and trivial_quote); metadata_only_none is new.
